ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Feeding Our Future Fraud Case
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in the Feeding Our Future fraud case and identify potential weaknesses in the system that allowed the fraud to occur.
questions: How did the fraudsters launder the money?
What steps can be taken to prevent similar fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a larger issue with the state's handling of federal funds and could lead to meaningful reforms.
